note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; participants, parties and the sequence are as supplied (sequence as configured, illustrative) and carry no legal meaning. No preset states a required speaking order, which side goes first, time allowed per turn or any consequence of a turn; a pending turn only means waiting. Coordinator decision (standing stress rule, 2026-09-26, AUTHORING item 20): the long-labels-stress count is capped to the baseline's four participants (texts stay near-maximum); see that preset's description.
